title: Termwise restricted resolutions with their pinned section comparison exist.
statement:
Termwise restricted resolutions with their pinned section comparison exist. For all objects and arguments in the following signature, using [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], [def-sc-open-module-cohomology].

theorem restrictedResolutionSections_exists {X : Scheme.{uBC}} {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (U : X.Opens) :
    Nonempty (RestrictedResolutionSections I U)

source.place: Tags 01E1 and 01E4; restriction of resolutions and computation of cohomology from them

proof.text: Restrict I termwise using exact restriction and preservation of injectives. The single complex comparison supplies the augmentation. Construct the section chain isomorphism using restrictAppIso followed by the equality U.ι_image_top; naturality verifies its chain condition and its displayed components.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01E1 and 01E4; explicit comparison through the actual restricted resolution
